speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Sit on the bench. The jug is down now, and I am not taking it up again. Bread. It is yesterday's, and it is what there is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Yesterday's will do. I am not sending anyone into the frost for a new loaf.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The water is the same water, sir. I told you the second turning. I am eating, and I am not going up.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Two turnings is the stair we have. I am not rebuilding a house before dinner because a jug cooled. Eat.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating. The sheet is where I left it. I am going back up when this is done, and I am not taking the jug.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then the jug stays here. I have one pair of hands, and they are on the bread.
